title: Implement Robust Inventory Onboarding Workflow
result_summary: Implemented channel-agnostic Inventory State Machine (13 steps), Session Store (InMemory), and API Endpoints. Verified with test script.
goal: Implement the authoritative, channel-agnostic, state-driven Inventory Onboarding Workflow as defined in the updated requirements.

context.requirement: Replace simple Seller logic with a deterministic State Machine backed by API endpoints and Session persistence.

sub_tasks.output: Implement State Machine Logic (Greeting -> Intent -> Property Specs -> Summary)

acceptance_criteria: API /inventory/step correctly transitions states (e.g., CATEGORY -> TYPE)
Draft inventory is stored temporarily before commit
Commit endpoint writes to Postgres SSOT
Flow works identically for mocked WhatsApp/Voice inputs
